From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Subject: Proposed POC evaluation roadmap and decision criteria — Acme Insights

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for walking us through the use cases this morning. Quick recap and a proposed 4-week evaluation roadmap so we can lock dates and owners. Please review and flag anything that needs changing.

Scope we discussed
- Document understanding + retrieval-augmented generation for onboarding docs and support tickets
- ~200k tokens of representative corpus (you mentioned a filtered export)

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — success criteria (proposed)
1) Quality: retrieval+RAG relevance: precision@5 >= 0.78; recall on labeled test set >= 0.85
2) Latency: p95 generation < 220ms (API end-to-end) for interactive flows
3) Cost: baseline unit cost <= $0.002/token for steady inference profile
4) Security/compliance: run in VPC (no third-party sharing) and retention set to 30 days

Milestones & owners
- Week 0 (prep): dataset handoff, NDA/SOW sign — Owner: Acme (Alex/Sanjay)
- Week 1: baseline deploy + ingestion — Owner: Ben (Redwood)
- Week 2: tuning and eval harness — Owner: Marissa (Redwood)
- Week 3: joint QA, edge cases, and KPI verification — Owners: cross-team
- Week 4: decision review + final metrics and next-step recommendations

Attachments: poc_eval_outline_v1.xlsx (outline + proposed test sets) and a short SOW draft.

Open questions for you
- Can you confirm the labelled test set size and a target PO / procurement timeline?
- Any changes to the success metrics above?
- Preferred kickoff week (we suggested wk of Sep 6)

If that looks good we’ll circulate an updated one-pager and calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — this is very helpful and close to what we need. A few notes/questions from our side: 

- Success metrics: can we tweak precision@5 target to >= 0.80 and explicitly add a recall-on-entities metric (entity extraction recall >= 0.82) for our onboarding flow?
- Data: I’ll share a 30k sample labeled set and we can use that as the canonical evaluation set. Expect that upload by EOD Tuesday.
- Procurement: procurement needs an estimated SOW value to open a PO request. Can you provide a budget range (ballpark) for a 4-week engagement?
- Timeline: Sept 6 kickoff works for our team — procurement expects final SOW by Aug 30 if possible.

Also please include our security contact (Sanjay Reddy) on the next thread — he’ll ask a couple of SOC2 / retention questions.
